I'm a third-year undergraduate in the School of Software at Chung-Ang University in Seoul.

I'm interested in using **statistics and data to support better decisions**:
framing the right question, choosing a method that fits it, and turning the result
into something people can act on. I plan to pursue a graduate degree in data science.

On this site I write about my [projects](projects.qmd), with a focus on *why* I chose
each method, what trade-offs I accepted, and what I learned from the results.

### Education
